# Deborah Morris Home Team

> Deborah & Chuck Morris, REALTORS® with Keller Williams Advantage Realty, serving Seminole County, Orange County, Lake County, Volusia County & surrounding areas in Central Florida since 2012.

Deborah Morris (Primary Listing Agent, FL Lic. #SL3258271) brings a background in interior design and furniture, with a focus on staging and presenting homes. Charles "Chuck" Morris (Primary Buyer Agent, FL Lic. #SL3340733) brings a field-engineer and IT background. Together they operate as the Deborah Morris Home Team, REALTORS®, affiliated with Keller Williams Advantage Realty (FL Lic. #BK3454836).

More than 70% of the team's business comes from repeat clients and referrals. Contact: 321-348-0014, info@DeborahMorrisHomeTeam.com.
